notes.title: DLC Announcement: Pearl Harbor 1941!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43976980/80d5936c39e27c1926753d1c97c51f32eb06ae88.png[/img]
[h3]Hello Beach Invasion fans, today we bring you the news of the Pearl Harbor DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390480/Beach_Invasion_1945__Pacific/][b]Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific[/b][/url] that will introduce all new game content! Some of the new features are:
[list]
[*] The DLC will focus on the beginnings of the US involvement of the Pacific front, in particular, the Japanese surprise attacks on Pearl Harbor and Wake Island on December 8th, 1941. 
[*] DLC will introduce two new maps, Pearl Harbor and Wake Island, with new gameplay features!
[*] Pearl Harbor scenario will focus on battleship USS Nevada's defense against the aerial and naval attacks (no landings will happen)
[*] New enemy types include: Aichi D3A dive bomber, Nakajima B5N torpedo bomber, Type A Japanese Midget Submarine, Mitsubishi T-14 torpedo boat, Japanese melee infantry with katana!
[*] New weapons include: Water cooled .50 cal M2 Browning, Oerlikon 20mm, Bofors twin 40mm, 1.1-inch/25cal "Chicago Piano", 5-inch/25cal gun!
[*] Mortar support is now replaced with aircraft support which will let you take control of the rear-gun of Douglas SBD Dauntless!
[*] Aircraft in V-formation
[*] Naval mines and floating explosive barrels
[*] Navy crew on the battleship
[/list]
Stay tuned for more details to come soon!

On other news, [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008851]Beach Invasion 1944[/url] is coming to [b]Playstation 5[/b] very soon, don't forget to add to your [b]wishlist[/b]!
[/h3]

notes.title: Major Update for Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific: New Maps and more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-dggLzJjzsE;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello Beach Invasion fans, today we announce the first major content update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/2390480/]Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific![/url]
With this content update, Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific gets two new playable maps, [b]Peleliu[/b] for the Japanese and [b]Attu, Alaska[/b] for the Americans. The update also introduces:
[list]
[*] New weapons for each map, [b]Type 11 LMG[/b] for Peleliu, [b]M45 Quadmount[/b] and [b]M3 Stuart[/b] for Alaska
[*] Two new enemy types for each map, [b]DUKW[/b](Amphibious Truck) and [b]Seep[/b](Sea Jeep) for Peleliu, and [b]Fu-go balloons[/b] and [b]Type-2 Ka-mi[/b] amphibious tanks for Alaska 
[*] The new M45 Quadmt. also replaces one of the 6-inch guns in the Philippines map
[*] GPU,CPU and memory optimization
[*] New music
[*] New weather conditions in the Alaska map: snow and blizzard
[*] Damaged trees can be broken in the Peleliu map
[*] Achivement system reworked: Wave completions changed:  10>5, 20>10, 50>20, 100>35, 200>50, 500>75, 1000>100
[/list]
[h3]Other changes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Supply box intervals increased to 45 from 30 for COOP
[*] Siren sounds decreased
[*] Rocket trucks aiming and firing reworked
[*] Plane health and speed reworked
[*] Infantry movement reworked in the Philippines
[*] Killcams fixed
[*] Weapon healths reworked
[*] Fog amount adjusted for each map
[*] Landing crafts do not disappear immediately when going back
[*] Ricochet chances increased
[*] Max FPS limited for resource consumption
[*] Aiming for weapons reworked
[*] Mouse sensitivity reworked
[*] Sound attenuation adjusted
[/list]

notes.title: Release Announcement: Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific is out!!!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390480/Beach_Invasion_1945__Pacific/][h1][u]Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific[/u][/h1][/url]
[h3]Adjust your sights, fix your bayonets and dig into your trenches, we have some good news for you!  We are happy to announce the release of the next installment in the Beach Invasion series! This time we are taking you to the tropical islands in the Pacific during the Second World War, to defend against endless invasion forces!

So let's talk about the unique features of our sequel game: 

[list]
🎮 The biggest one being the [b]online COOP feature[/b], which will allow two players to play on a map , trying to defend against invaders together. (On a technical note, online multiplayer meant that almost all of the programming of the game had to be re-written from scratch.)

🌏Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific allows you to play from both sides(Japanese and American), in two new maps! You can either play as a [b]Japanese defender on the Iwo Jima map[/b], or as an [b]American-Filipino defender on the Philippines map[/b].

🎯[b]New weapon types[/b]! We are introducing new weapons such as the [b]automatic firing triple barreled AA gun[/b], or the [b]naval gun batteries[/b] of the Fort Drum(concrete battleship).

⚔️[b]New enemy types[/b]! In addition to infantry, tanks, boat and planes, we now added [b]rocket-launcher[/b] on tanks, trucks, and boats, as well as [b]amphibious[/b] vehicles and heavy bombers that drop incendiary [b]napalm bombs[/b]!

💥Updated and improved [b]visual and sound effects[/b]! Flares, lighting and much more!
[/list]

Our team worked very hard to deliver a bug-free game with all feature completed, but as we are a small team, some small bugs here and there might have slipped our eyes. If you encounter any problems, please report them, cheers! Have a nice holiday season![/h3]

[previewyoutube=cof0KjMvYOI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NEW GAME MODE AND OTHER UPDATES!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we hope you are still enjoying Beach Invasion 1944. Today we bring news about a [b]major update[/b] to the game, the long requested [b]Sandbox Mode[/b]! 

[h2]Sandbox Mode[/h2]
So what exactly is Sandbox mode? When you want to start a new game, you will have the option the choose between [b]Progressive[/b] (the current game mode) and [b]Sandbox[/b]. In the Sandbox game mode, you will start a game in which you can choose the [u]number and types of enemies (Infantry, armored vehicles, planes, boats), the time of the day, and the weather condition[/u]. All weapons will be available, with 3 artillery calls, and several mines will be randomly placed on the map. If you defeat all the enemies, you will achieve victory, and if all your weapons are disabled, you will face defeat.

Sandbox mode will not affect your Progress, and when you resume your progressive game, it will continue from where you last saved. You won't be able to get some achivements from only playing the sandbox.
 [i]Besides the new game mode we have also;[/i]

[h3]Fixed bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage and repair bug for Mg42 (7th place)
[*] German soldiers obstructing view, going to places where they're not supposed to go
[*] Some bugs about achivements visibility
[/list]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dutch language
[*] Ukrainian language
[/list]
[h2]New game in development![/h2]
On other news, Steam page for our next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390480/Beach_Invasion_1945__Pacific/][b]Beach Invasion 1945-Pacific[/b][/url] is now online! Go check it out and don't forget to [b]follow[/b] for updates and [b]add to your wishlist[/b]!

notes.title: Update Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thanks again for your support and patience. 
Today we are happy to announce our first update for our game, addressing some of the immediate issues about the game according to the feedback we got from you:
[list]
[*] You can now resume from where you left
[*] Mouse invert axis added to the options menu
[*] You can now scroll through weapons with the mouse wheel
[*] You can now hide and unhide the hud (press h) to take more cinematic shots
[*] Adjusted camera movement when switching between weapons
[*] Updated German language and added Hungarian language
[*] Increased the number and efficiency of the troops on our side
[*] Other bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: ROADMAP!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we've had a successful game launch and wanted to share the joy with our  players. However this doesn't mean we are done with the game, there's still bugs to fix, features to implement, so we wanted to share a [b]Roadmap[/b] with you for the game's future. 

Immediate concerns:
[list]
[*] Saving your progress to continue later
[*] Invert Y-axis option for mouse control
[*] Language fixes
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]
We will also explore the possibilities of:
[list]
[*] VR support
[*] Porting to gaming consoles
[*] Coop play option
[*] More maps from other fronts with different factions
[*] Leaderboards and online stats
[*] Optional mods like zombie skins or holiday season accessories
[*] And more...
[/list]
